errors.text_span: и се покачва до 12% през 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The description states that the orange line, representing growth, "rises to 12% in 2023". This is an oversimplification of the trend. The values fluctuate from year to year (10%, 9%, 13%, 16%, 14%, 12%), it does not simply rise.
The description does not mention the presence of the legend at the bottom of the chart, which identifies the blue area as 'B2B пазар (в трлн. долара)' and the orange line as 'Ръст'.
